messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take hydroxyzine if you:
are allergic to hydroxyzine or to any ingredient in the medicine
are allergic to cetirizine or levocetirizine
have a prolonged QT interval, a heart rhythm finding seen on an electrocardiogram (ECG)
are in early pregnancy
In animal studies, hydroxyzine caused birth defects in rats and mice at doses well above those used in people.
There is not enough information in humans to know whether hydroxyzine is safe in early pregnancy.
Therefore, hydroxyzine should not be used at that time.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "caused birth defects in", "rats"]

The relation 'caused birth defects in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug caused the specified adverse developmental outcome in the animal species mentioned as the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
